title: Jonas Called
description: Jonas called the residence. He said it wasn't urgent. His voice was the tone he uses when something has been building for a long time and he has decided it is finally time to say it.

title: Liora Is in Custody
description: The Second Precinct has Liora in a holding room following a demonstration on the parliament steps. There's a photographer's shot circulating that will run in the evening edition. She hasn't asked for help. That may be the problem.

title: The Headmaster's Office
description: Ashenmere Academy called. Tomas has missed six of the last fourteen school days. Staff found him near Kravenstal Station in the company of older students. The headmaster says they are 'concerned' and would like to discuss it in person.

title: Constitutional Draft — Last Amendments
description: This is the final week for amendments before the draft goes to referendum printing. Whatever the document says on Friday is what the country votes on.

title: Budget Allocation — Referendum Week Preparation
description: Ensure the fiscal framework can withstand whichever direction the referendum takes. A 'yes' means implementation costs. A 'no' means political crisis spending. Both require reserves.

title: Nadia Voss — Investigation Update
description: Voss sent a preliminary list of questions. Some of them reference documents she shouldn't know exist. Danika wants to know if there's a leak in the BNI archives or if Voss is just very good at her job.

title: Refugee Crisis — Winter Preparations
description: Winter is three weeks away. The camps at Ondra need winterization. Interior says the budget covers tents, not heating. The first frost is forecast for next week.

title: The Ledger
description: An unmarked envelope arrives — photocopied ledger pages from the highway project, several entries circled in red. A hand-written note in the margin is in handwriting you almost recognize.
